findings.source_issue: The source says second-order logic can say anything said in a first-order language without a special supply of nonlogical symbols. Replacing relation/function names with second-order variables only preserves the original interpretation relative to matching assignments; binding those variables does not keep the same sentence truth conditions.
findings.minimal_treatment: State the assignment-dependent translation using free relation/function variables, and disclose that quantifying them would change the proposition.
